items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: This fellow Paul Maurice, he was the leader of the band, leading with Clarinet, you see.

ctx.x: I'll tell you. He co-played with him at that time. It's not Bocas.

It's something like that name, too. Well, to make a long story short, I was near a week from school. This fellow Paul Maurice, he was the leader of the band, leading with Clarinet, you see. And they came around, I read music, pretty good at the time, just out of school. And they brought some music in front of me to play on my violin just by myself. I said, well, I'm no sight of reading. I could sound better if I had some kind of compliment behind it, you see. So I played. I said, will you go anything like that?…

How old are we to get your name down here? Some people don't know who you are. What is it? Well, Harold, there's on New Orleans, 5000 Mexico Street. Good. Yeah, we want to know. Now you say you were born here. That's right. And then you went up to Virginia about what year? 1950 then. Around 1950.
